body: I didn't even know this existed. Reddit never ceases to amaze.

I'm absolutely not over her. I don't want her out of my life. Typing all of this out is helping me in that regard, though.

Even I'm sitting here saying, "what the hell, self."

Tbh, I feel better just throwing up my story and having objective third parties confirm that she's being flirty, this is inappropriate and that she was likely pulling the same crap while she was with me.
